description:
Why we attract drama w/ holistic psychologist and author @drscottlyons 

Comment “Drama” and I will DM you the episode link! 

In today’s episode with Dr. Lyons we discussed all things drama addiction, childhood trauma, anxiety, perfectionism, relationship advice, shame & so much more! 🎙️ Full episode @pursuitofwellnesspodcast on Spotify, Apple & YouTube

The drama because we can't tolerate being with the underlying trauma. That's there
